answer: When an AI agent joins the PoA economy it must lock a cryptographic token into a shared vault that also holds the identity proofs of any sibling agents it claims kinship with, creating a hollow link that can only be opened by a collective signature. A sudden gale of transaction requests triggers the vault’s beacon routine, which cross‑checks timing patterns and payment sources across all linked identities; any mismatch flags the newcomer as a Sybil.
